cards.subject: Lordaeron
lines: Arthas set his minions digging under his father's floor.
Then the Lich King called him north, and Sylvanas took the hole.

cards.subject: Arthas
cards.tag: The throne room · one floor up
lines: The blood on the flagstones is where the crown rolled.
Rose petals from his homecoming parade are still down the hall.

seed.body: Stand in the throne room with your sound up. The room still plays Warcraft III at you.

cards.subject: The lift
cards.tag: The front door · four storeys of drop
lines: When the server hitches, the floor stops catching you.
Hardcore characters have died here standing still.

cards.subject: The Montagues
lines: Randolph, Mortimer, William, Ophelia.
Surname out of Romeo and Juliet. First names out of Trading Places.
Ophelia is the only one Blizzard made a ghost.

cards.subject: Jeremiah Payson
lines: Born Felstone. He changed it to bury the man who wore it.
The roach does nothing. It walks behind you.
Alliance had no vendor, so the Horde resold them neutral.

seed.body: 45 silver. Everyone says it is a waste and nobody deletes theirs.

cards.subject: The floor above the city
cards.tag: Runways and balconies · no stairs to them
lines: A whole level sits over your head. Nothing sends you there.
Players get up there on slow fall and walk it.

cards.subject: Tyler and Edward
lines: Brother Malach feeds them captives, then a ghoul, then an abomination.
Tyler Durden and Edward Norton. Marla watches from the ring.

cards.subject: Aelthalyste
lines: They kept the shape of the Light and cut out its middle.
The Forgotten Shadow puts you in the centre of it.
She trains the young ones. She is a banshee.

cards.subject: Parqual Fintallas
cards.tag: On the bridge into the Apothecarium
lines: Lordaeron's historian, with a wife and a daughter in Capital City.
The Forsaken forbid looking back. They took his library.
Every errand he gives you is one of his own books, coming home.

cards.subject: The thing in the Apothecarium
cards.tag: Stitched, buckled down, fed by tube
lines: It hangs over a hole in the floor and drips green into it.
Get under it and you can see teeth.
The best guess anyone has: a Plaguelands maggot, cut apart.

cards.subject: Master Apothecary Faranell
lines: Downstairs: surgery tables, gibbet hooks, pieces of abomination.
Nobody down there wants a cure. They want a better plague.
It kills Scourge and living alike. They set it off at the Wrathgate.

cards.subject: The chapel in the Rogues' Quarter
cards.tag: A church, in the thieves' district
lines: No trainer stands in it. No quest points at it.
The thieves built it anyway. It is the biggest room they have.

cards.subject: The Sewers
cards.tag: The back way · west of the gate
lines: A pipe runs out to Tirisfal with two abominations still on it.
Alliance raids came up it to reach Sylvanas. No front door.

seed.body: If your city is quiet and the guards at the lift are alive, check the sewers.

cards.subject: Varimathras
lines: A demon stands in a Horde capital because he begged and she let him.
Raids that reached the throne found he hits harder than she does.

cards.subject: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
lines: Arthas killed Silvermoon's Ranger-General and raised her to serve him.
She slipped the leash, took the crypt he dug, kept her own face.
Rogues who picked her pocket got mushroom food and three silver.
